postData.contentHtml:
The cricketing world turns its eyes to Seddon Park in Hamilton as New Zealand faces India in the highly anticipated third One Day International. With India already holding a commanding 2-0 lead in the five-match series, this upcoming fixture is nothing short of a do-or-die battle for the Blackcaps. A win for India on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 (or Monday, November 9, in some regions), would seal the series with two games to spare, while a New Zealand victory would inject life back into the contest.

Where to Catch the Action Live:

Cricket fans globally can tune into this critical clash. Here's your guide to watching the 3rd ODI:

  • USA: Tune in on Monday, November 9, 2026, at 9 p.m. ET. Willow TV (cable/satellite) is your broadcast home. Streaming options include Fubo and the Willow by Cricbuzz app/website (subscriptions required).
  • India: The match kicks off on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 7:30 a.m. IST. Catch it live on the Sony Sports Network (Sony Ten 1, Sony Ten 3) with multiple language feeds. Streaming is available via the SonyLIV app and website (subscription required).
  • New Zealand: For local fans, the action begins on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 3 p.m. NZDT. Sky Sport NZ will broadcast the match, with streaming accessible through Sky Go and Sky Sport Now.
  • United Kingdom: Early risers can watch on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 2 a.m. GMT. TNT Sports 1 will provide coverage, and streaming is available via discovery+ or packages including TNT Sports.

Pitch Report, Weather & Key Factors:

Both previous matches in the series were affected by rain, leading to decisions by the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method. The forecast for Hamilton suggests more wet weather, which could again play a significant role. The Seddon Park pitch is anticipated to favor seam bowling, making the toss a crucial moment. Historically, New Zealand boasts an impressive record at Seddon Park, having won their last 12 completed ODIs at the venue – a streak they desperately need to extend.

Team News:

India, under the captaincy of Shubman Gill for this match, is expected to maintain its winning combination. Key batsmen like Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli will lead the charge, supported by Shreyas Iyer and KL Rahul. Their young pace attack, including Anshul Kamboj, Auqib Nabi, Gurnoor Brar, and Arshdeep Singh, has performed commendably.

New Zealand faces selection challenges due to injuries, with Blair Tickner, Matt Henry, and Lockie Ferguson sidelined. Captain Mitchell Santner will lead a side hoping for strong performances from players like Will Young, Tim Seifert, Henry Nicholls, and Daryl Mitchell to turn their fortunes around.

The Stakes Are High:

This 3rd ODI is more than just a match; it's a test of resilience for New Zealand and an opportunity for India to assert complete dominance. With the 2027 Cricket World Cup roughly a year away, both teams are also using this series for crucial preparation in challenging conditions. Social sentiment surrounding the match is generally positive, reflecting the high anticipation and fan engagement for this crucial cricketing encounter.
postData.title: Blackcaps' Last Stand: New Zealand Battles India in Crucial 3rd ODI
postData.summary: India leads the ODI series 2-0, putting immense pressure on New Zealand to secure a victory in the third match at Seddon Park to keep their hopes alive. Get ready for a high-stakes encounter, despite looming weather concerns. Find out how and where to watch this pivotal game live.
